base_url.description: Base URL of the Bahmni OpenMRS instance, e.g. http://localhost/openmrs for a local Bahmni/bahmni-docker deployment.

username.description: OpenMRS username for HTTP Basic authentication.

password.description: OpenMRS password for HTTP Basic authentication; never logged or printed.

patient_query.description: Identifier or name search term used to enumerate the patients stream (OpenMRS patient search q).

patient_uuid.description: Patient UUID context used to scope patient-linked streams (encounters, observations, visits, orders, lab results, appointments, diagnoses).

appointment_date.description: ISO-8601 date/datetime used to scope the appointments stream to a single scheduling day; without it (or patient_uuid) the appointments read is not scoped and returns the deployment's whole appointment book in one response.
